description: This Python source file defines a helper class 'LiteLLM_Proxy_MCP_Handler' with static methods for managing MCP (Multi-Channel Protocol) integration with the Responses API in a language model system. The class includes methods for parsing tools, filtering, deduplicating, transforming MCP tools for OpenAI compatibility, executing tool calls, extracting calls from responses, handling streaming responses, and managing tool execution events. It facilitates complex workflows like MCP discovery, tool invocation, and response streaming within a language model processing pipeline.
